انعتقن (form VII)
# اِنْعَتَقْنَ (inʕataqna) /in.ʕa.taq.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْعَتَقَ (inʕataqa)
# اِنْعَتِقْنَ (inʕatiqna) /in.ʕa.tiq.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْعَتَقَ (inʕataqa)
